title: Malicious SHA-256 file hash b18ef28c6c0a… (OffSeq Mirage)
description: A malicious file identified by the SHA-256 hash b18ef28c6c0ab3b74f2eb936fe611ecab8ac0527d0ce9da11eb029c69eb4b32a was observed by OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors on November 23, 2026. This file was detected twice in attacker activity originating from infrastructure in Germany. The observed attack technique is T1105 (Ingress Tool Transfer), indicating the file is likely a payload such as a dropper, web shell, miner, or post-exploitation tool used during an attack. Organizations are advised to check their environments and security tools for this hash to detect potential compromise.
